paper_title: Coherence of Gray Categories via Rewriting
statement: (and interchangers are oriented as usual). By Knuth-Bendix completion, we add the two rules on the right. The resulting rewriting system has 19 joinable critical pairs, to each of which corresponds a relation. We conjecture that the rewriting system is terminating, which would give rise to a coherence theorem for Frobenius monoids.
